scientific_limitations_integrity: The theorem is restricted to the qutrit spin-one interpolation and to Choi PPT/negativity. It does not determine quantum or private capacities. The exact noisy Werner-Holevo family is prior literature from 2023--2024, the \(p=1\) endpoint non-entanglement-breaking property is prior, and NPT at \(p=1/2\) is explicitly prior in 2026; originality is limited to the complete partial-transpose spectrum, the full piecewise negativity profile, the all-parameter NPT conclusion as a single theorem, and the identification of \(p=2/3\) as the unique negativity minimum. The analytic proof is replayed by exact rational matrix identities.
title: Exact Choi-negativity profile of the spin-one Lie-algebra channel
